selftext:
Let me know if you have any issue's running it, thanks!

comments.author: rmfrost
comments.body:
I've gotten it to run, but it has moments where it just completely freezes for quite some time. I pick a character, wait for some loading thing, and am immediately thrust into what feels like a boss battle with overly detailed graphics and everything on the screen is competing for my attention, my eye isn't naturally led to rest on anything anywhere.

I mean, the game feels like it's got bones to work with, but the archer doesn't move fast enough to dodge all of the enemy's mechanics and survive long enough to "out DPS the foe".

replies.author: SanDiegoMeat666
replies.body: Awesome feedback thank you. I had it built for codepen so its literally running on a single 6k line html file, super impractical haha. Ill break that up and use node.js, should solve the horrible freezies. As for the gameplay, I agree it just straight up tosses you in, I was so focused on certain details that a lot of other things took the backseat. I'll hit the points you covered on my next update, I appreciate it!
